confirm_form.check_zelle: Before confirming, check in your Zelle that you received **US$ {{amount}}**.

confirm_form.reference_hint: Copy it from the receipt or your bank, for example 001234567890. Spaces, dots and hyphens are removed.

confirm_form.reference_label_binance: Binance Pay order ID or TxID

confirm_form.note_hint: For example: paid from her husband's account.
confirm_form.note_too_long: The note can have up to {{max}} characters.
confirm_form.reused_title: That reference was already used in another paid order
confirm_form.reused_body: Orders with that reference: {{codes}}. If it really is a different payment, you can confirm it anyway.
confirm_form.success_unnamed: Payment confirmed. They have access now.

reject_form.intro: Use it when the payment didn't arrive or doesn't match the order.
reject_form.reason_hint: For example: we couldn't find the payment in the bank. The buyer will see it in their order and in the email, if we send it.
reject_form.reason_invalid: Write a reason of 3 to 300 characters.
reject_form.success_notified: Order rejected. We let them know by email.

void_form.warning: Removes access to everything in this order.
void_form.intro: Only use it if you marked it as paid by mistake.
void_form.reason_hint: It stays in the order. We don't email the buyer.
void_form.reason_invalid: Write a reason of 3 to 300 characters.
void_form.success: Order voided. They no longer have access to what it included.

manual_area.title: Manual payments
manual_area.intro: Buyers pay on their own and send you the receipt by WhatsApp. You confirm each payment in Orders.

manual_card.fix_fields: Check the fields marked in red.
manual_card.too_long: It can have up to {{max}} characters.
manual_card.save_error: We couldn't save the changes. Please try again.
manual_card.load_error: We couldn't load these details. Please try again in a moment.
manual_card.holder_hint_bank: As it appears at the bank.

bank.label: Bank
bank.code_hint_transfer: 4 digits. If you leave it empty, we take it from the account.

manual_settings.title: Manual payment settings
manual_settings.tagline: They apply to every manual method.
manual_settings.no_whatsapp: Without the WhatsApp you can't turn on any method.
manual_settings.whatsapp_hint: With the country code, for example 58 424 8824634. Every method uses it: the receipts arrive there.
manual_settings.whatsapp_country: The country code is missing (58 for Venezuela)
manual_settings.whatsapp_error: Write the WhatsApp number with the country code, for example 58 424 8824634.
manual_settings.window_hint: If they don't pay in time, the order expires by itself.
manual_settings.window_error: The time limit must be between 1 and 168 hours.
manual_settings.fx_note: Pago Móvil and bank transfers use it to work out the amount in bolivars.
manual_settings.fx_manual_hint: For example 887,30. Used instead of the BCV rate while the manual rate is chosen.
manual_settings.rate_error: Write the rate in Bs. per dollar, for example 887,30.
manual_settings.rate_ambiguous: Write the rate with 2 decimals (for example 887,30) so it isn't read as thousands.
manual_settings.rate_preview: It will be saved as {{rate}} Bs. per US$
manual_settings.rate_far: This rate is more than 50 % away from today's BCV rate ({{bcv}} Bs. per US$). Check that it is written correctly.
manual_settings.notify_hint: We write to this address every time a new order arrives.
manual_settings.save_error: We couldn't save the settings. Please try again.
manual_settings.load_error: We couldn't load the manual payment settings.
manual_settings.needed_whatsapp: To remove the WhatsApp, first turn Pago Móvil off: it uses it for the receipts.
manual_settings.needed_rate: Write the manual rate: Pago Móvil uses it to work out the amount in bolivars.
manual_settings.fx_error_hint: Meanwhile, you can choose the manual rate and type it yourself.
manual_settings.help: Every order arrives in Orders: you confirm it there once the money arrives.
